name: Stalwart Mail Server
tagline: Modern Rust-based mail server. JMAP, IMAP4, SMTP, sieve, anti-spam.
shortDescription: Stalwart is a modern mail server written in Rust. JMAP, IMAP4, SMTP, Sieve filtering, built-in anti-spam, full-text search, directory integration. The all-in-one mail platform.
longDescription:
## What it is

Stalwart is a modern mail server written in Rust. JMAP (the new email standard), IMAP4, SMTP, Sieve filtering, built-in anti-spam (Greylist, RBL, DMARC, DKIM, ARC, SPF), full-text search, LDAP/SQL/Postgres directory integration.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a mail server that is fast, secure, and feature-complete without the 1990s-era Postfix/Dovecot complexity, Stalwart is the answer. The single binary replaces Postfix + Dovecot + SpamAssassin + OpenDKIM.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted email for a business or organization
- Replacing a Postfix + Dovecot setup with one binary
- When you want JMAP (modern email protocol)
- Privacy-sensitive deployments (your own mail server)
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name stalwart -p 25:25 -p 587:587 -p 993:993 stalwartlabs/mail-server
```

**Single binary:** Download from GitHub releases, run `./stalwart-mail start`.
pricingDetails: Free. AGPL-3.0 licensed. Single binary, low resource use.
